profile_md: Reduced-depth review (about 12 searches plus page fetches). The strongest verified provision is in engineering: 60-credit Industrial Group Projects in MEng/BEng Computer Systems Engineering (compulsory in the MEng additional year; projects from industry collaborators or research groups, presented to academic staff and industry professionals) and Mechanical Engineering (groups define and solve a problem with industry collaborators and present to an industry client). Neither page states that every project has an external client, and the Computer Systems page mixes in internal research-group projects, so employer connection is rated Unclear for that route; the Mechanical page's course listing is for 2026-27 entry. In business, the Postgraduate Consultancy Project gives genuine company-set briefs but is individual (excluded); the Group Consulting Project at Coventry University London is a team format but an undated employer-facing offer with no credit or cohort evidence. Media, design and business-degree pages refer to real clients or live briefs, but group basis, client role and standard-ness are unevidenced. No university-wide or central route qualifies: Global Opportunities and Global Leaders are mobility/award schemes. Provision appears isolated within programmes. Uncertain: current delivery dates, partner coverage and participation numbers.
gaps: Not researched in depth: Manufacturing Engineering IGP Initiation/Execution (search summary only); Interactive Media Integrative Project; MA Product Design Innovation live briefs; Business Analytics and Marketing consultancy options; health and nursing; Coventry Law School beyond clinic; module specifications/handbooks (not fetched); Computer Science/Software Engineering group projects (no client evidence). Further departmental instances likely. WebFetch returned model-summarised extracts, not raw page text. Search results show 'Coventry Business School' and 'College of Business and Law' naming variants.
